challenges.title: Sawan Somwar · four Mondays
challenges.blurb: Each Sawan Monday: jal + bilva (or water) for Shiva, aarti once, katha once. Health first.

challenges.title: Hanuman Chalisa · 7 mornings
challenges.blurb: Read or listen once each morning for seven days. Streak-light — miss a day, continue without guilt.

challenges.title: Learn one aarti this week
challenges.blurb: Pick Ganesha, Lakshmi, or Devi aarti. Repeat on three evenings.

challenges.title: Ekadashi katha · next vow day
challenges.blurb: Before your next Ekadashi fast (or partial fast), read the vrat katha once.

diwali.title: My Diwali home checklist
items: Buy or set diyas / LED lamps
Share sweets with a neighbour or friend
Optional: temple visit or livestream aarti

navaratri.title: My Navaratri home checklist
items: Set a small kalash or Devi photo
Devi aarti for nine evenings (or as many as you can)
If abroad: note local garba night timing

karva-chauth.title: My Karva Chauth home checklist
items: Sargi / early meal plan if observing fast
Listen to / read Karva Chauth katha
Thank elders who helped with the vrat

chhath-puja.title: My Chhath Puja checklist
items: Rest and hydrate after vrat ends

shravan-sawan.title: My Sawan / Shravan home checklist
items: Note local Sawan start/end on a panchang
Keep a copper/steel lota for Shiva abhishek
Sawan Somwar: read katha + Om Jai Shiv Omkara
Offer bilva or a sincere Namah Shivaya
Optional: Ganga aarti listen / short kanwar seva
Nag Panchami: milk offering + teach kindness about snakes
Raksha Bandhan / Shravan Purnima closing thanks

holi.title: My Holi home checklist
items: Holika Dahan: safe distance / community rules
Visit / call elders with gulaal wishes
Clean courtyard after play; thank helpers

maha-shivaratri.title: My Maha Shivaratri checklist
items: Keep bilva, water, and clean cloth ready
Om Jai Shiv Omkara or Shiva chalisa
Gentle sattvic meal plan if fasting

janmashtami.title: My Janmashtami home checklist
items: Krishna aarti at midnight or local temple time
Optional: dahi handi / community program note

ganesh-chaturthi.title: My Ganesh Chaturthi checklist
items: Choose eco-friendly murti or photo altar
Read Ganesha elephant-head or door-guardian story
Daily lamp for installed days (as per family)
Visarjan plan: local rules + eco immersion

ram-navami.title: My Ram Navami checklist
items: Read Kaikeyi boons / Rama homecoming katha
Note nearby Ayodhya / Rama temple visit idea

hanuman-jayanti.title: My Hanuman Jayanti checklist
items: Read Sanjeevani or Hanuman seva story
Offer sindoor / jasmine / jaggery as per custom
Tuesday follow-up lamp if family keeps it

raksha-bandhan.title: My Raksha Bandhan checklist
items: Tilak + rakhi ritual at agreed time
Gift with a short blessing, not only money
Photo message to family WhatsApp group

dussehra.title: My Dussehra / Vijayadashami checklist
items: Read Ravana-vadh or Durga victory story
Shastra / tools / books puja if family custom
Plant a good habit as ‘victory’ vow

govardhan-puja.title: My Govardhan Puja / Annakut checklist
items: Prepare mountain-shaped / multi-dish bhog if possible
Giriraj / Govardhan photo or cow seva donation
Avoid litter on any hill / park outing

makar-sankranti.title: My Makar Sankranti checklist
items: Dawn arghya to Surya if custom
Note Pongal / Lohri cousins in the same season

lohri.title: My Lohri checklist
items: Safe bonfire plan / community ground rules
Invite neighbours; include new parents if any
Offer first handful to the fire with thanks

pongal.title: My Pongal checklist
items: New pot for sweet pongal if tradition
Bhogi / Surya / Mattu day plan as per family
Offer first boil overflow with ‘Pongalo Pongal’

gudi-padwa.title: My Gudi Padwa checklist
items: Prepare gudi (or photo altar if abroad)
Read new-year / Rama return regional note
Family blessings and new ledger / vow

ugadi.title: My Ugadi checklist
items: Oil bath / new clothes as custom
Temple visit or home Vishnu–Devi aarti

vaisakhi.title: My Vaisakhi checklist
items: Visit gurdwara or temple as your tradition
Donate to langar / food drive if you can

onam.title: My Onam checklist
items: Sadya menu or simplified banana-leaf meal
Traditional attire photo for family album

rath-yatra.title: My Rath Yatra checklist
items: Note local Jagannath / ISKCON rath timing
Prepare light snacks for procession day
Offer coconut / cloth as per local custom
Share prasad; rest feet after walk

dhanteras.title: My Dhanteras checklist
items: Buy token utensil / metal as family custom
Health vow: one good habit as ‘true dhan’

bhai-dooj.title: My Bhai Dooj checklist
items: Confirm sibling visit / video call time
Exchange gifts with a blessing sentence

guru-purnima.title: My Guru Purnima checklist
items: Message or visit with a simple gift
Donate books / education if you can
One hour of focused learning as seva

akshaya-tritiya.title: My Akshaya Tritiya checklist
items: Charity (anna / education) over impulse gold panic

vasant-panchami.title: My Vasant Panchami checklist
items: Wear yellow / keep yellow flowers if custom

kartik-purnima.title: My Kartik Purnima checklist
items: Dawn bath / lamp on water if safe & local
Temple or Pushkar / river visit idea
Donate oil / diya to a shrine

nag-panchami.title: My Nag Panchami checklist
items: Milk / flowers offering at home nag image
Teach children not to harm snakes
Avoid digging / plowing if family custom
Visit local nag shrine if any

tulsi-vivah.title: My Tulsi Vivah checklist
items: Prepare small wedding decor for tulsi
Start Kartik / Dev Diwali mood at home

santoshi-mata.title: My Santoshi Mata Friday checklist
items: Note Friday vrat rules your family follows
Read Santoshi Mata story / vrat katha
Give prasad to someone in need

sharad-purnima.title: My Sharad Purnima checklist
items: Prepare kheer under moonlight if custom
Share kheer next morning as prasad

chaitra-navaratri.title: My Chaitra Navaratri checklist
items: Daily Devi aarti plan (9 days or key days)
Note Ram Navami overlap if in season

kanwar-yatra.title: My Kanwar Yatra / seva checklist
items: If walking: hydration, shoes, ID, group plan
If supporting: water / medical seva stall idea
Respect traffic and local police guidance
Offer Ganga water only at proper shrines
Rest and thank helpers after return

hartalika-teej.title: My Hartalika Teej checklist
items: Note nirjala / fruit fast level you will keep
Moon / night break as per tradition
Share story with younger women in family

vat-savitri.title: My Vat Savitri checklist
items: Locate banyan / vat tree or home substitute ritual
Thread / sacred thread offering as custom
Pray for family longevity and courage

sheetala-ashtami.title: My Sheetala Ashtami checklist
items: Prepare cold / day-old food as family custom
Offer to neighbours if making basiri / cold meals

skanda-shashti.title: My Skanda Shashti checklist
items: Murugan / Kartikeya photo or vel symbol
Fast or fruit day as observed

thaipusam.title: My Thaipusam checklist
items: Note local Murugan temple procession time
Prepare milk pot / simple kavadi if participating

gangaur.title: My Gangaur checklist
items: Isar–Gauri procession note if in Rajasthan diaspora

parashurama-jayanti.title: My Parashurama Jayanti checklist
items: Act of justice / help someone wronged

sawan.title: My Sawan home checklist
items: Note local Sawan start/end on a panchang
Keep a copper/steel lota for Shiva abhishek
Sawan Somwar: read katha + Om Jai Shiv Omkara
Offer bilva or a sincere Namah Shivaya
Optional: Ganga aarti listen / short kanwar seva
Nag Panchami: milk offering + teach kindness about snakes
Raksha Bandhan / Shravan Purnima closing thanks
